notes: Horne Street lies along the west edge: only its east line is on the sheet (x ~246-270) and its centre (~x 160) falls just off the paper edge (~x 178), so Horne/Hopkins, Horne/Clark (T) and Horne/Gest are not recorded here (Horne/Hopkins and Horne/Gest are on sheet 57; Clark ends at Horne). Dalton Avenue is on the east edge: only its west line (x ~3764-3775) is drawn; Dalton x = west line + half the printed 60 ft, treat as +/-15. McLean is printed 100 ft; north of Clark its west line is lost under the C.H.&D. yard tracks, so McLean/Hopkins x uses the 100 ft width from the east line. Hopkins is printed 60 ft west of McLean and 50 ft east of McLean. Oehler is printed 'OEHLER (BLACKFORD)'. Curran Street enters from the north only (T at Hopkins).
